name: canvasight
description: A local canvas workspace for structured Codex prompts and generated image assets.

interface.shortDescription: Build prompt flows and trace project history
interface.longDescription: Canvasight opens a native Codex widget for arranging task nodes, managed assets, and flows, plus a separate visual history of protected project states. @Canvasight image requests can use Codex imagegen and add final images directly to the active Page as Asset Nodes. Runs return through the current Codex task's widget host bridge; browser fallback pages remain diagnostic.
defaultPrompt: Open Canvasight for the current Codex project workspace.
Open Canvasight and show the current project's visual history.
